objective: Repair the merged VS01-T01 macOS archive inspector so that it recognizes the observed APFS encryption fields, uniquely matches the selected archive volume to its APFS volume and container records, and derives fail-closed effective usable capacity from matching container and quota evidence, without changing public contracts, schemas, dependencies, CLI behavior, or archive state.
activated_user_visible_capability: The existing bsl archive inspect command truthfully interprets the owner-observed macOS APFS plist shape and can produce an accurate candidate profile for the provisioned BSL-Archive volume.
activated_invariants: The repair starts from merged main 3e9673640f08542279189d2f50c872a0723d5ca4 on a new branch and draft PR.
Only src/bsl/infrastructure/macos_volume.py is modified as handwritten production code.
ArchivePreflightReceipt and every other public contract and committed JSON Schema remain byte-identical to the base.
Runtime and development dependency names and versions remain unchanged.
Encryption evidence recognizes boolean APFSEncrypted, Encrypted, Encryption, and EncryptionThisVolumeProper fields plus the matched APFS volume entry's Encryption field.
Absent or conflicting encryption evidence remains fail-closed and never fabricates encrypted=true.
The selected volume must match exactly one APFS volume entry and its containing APFS container by live device identity and, when present, volume UUID.
Volume-level FreeSpace=0 and VolumeSize=0 do not override valid matching APFS container capacity evidence.
Effective free bytes are derived from valid nonnegative container CapacityFree and, for a positive valid quota, min(container_free, CapacityQuota minus CapacityInUse).
CapacityQuota=0 or an absent quota means no volume quota is applied; matching container free space remains the effective value.
Negative values, capacity free above container ceiling, quota above container ceiling, use above quota, ambiguous matches, and otherwise impossible capacity evidence fail closed.
No real volume is written, initialized, resized, renamed, mounted, unmounted, formatted, encrypted, repaired, or approved.
The live post-repair receipt and APFS snapshot remain owner-private under ignored .local paths; no stable device or volume identity enters Git, CI, the PR, or the public handoff.
All source-plan, stable-device, Thunderbolt, receipt-semantic, synthetic-promotion, and exact-head CI behavior from merged VS01-T01 remains regression-protected.
No source acquisition, VS01-T02, database, retrieval, benchmark execution, model, cloud, Lambda, Luna, training, evaluation, or billable work is introduced.
